open_leads.title: F5 NGINX unauthenticated remote code execution over HTTP/2 (CERT-FR CERTFR-2026-ALE-017)
open_leads.note: Two flaws, CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007, in NGINX Open Source and NGINX Plus. Unauthenticated RCE over HTTP/2. CERT-FR reports a public PoC for CVE-2026-123007 but no in-the-wild exploitation. Workaround: disable HTTP/2 until patched. Related: CERT-EU 2026-022 (critical NGINX). Not on file.

notes: Triage: 80 leads taken (77 government, 3 vendor). Cleared 0 by triage.mjs. Skipped 68; queued 12 (priority 1: 1, priority 2: 3, priority 3: 8). Many government items duplicate stories already on file (Oracle 18 Nov batch, Java4Shell, Citrix NetScaler, Check Point Gaia, Atlassian, GitLab, SharePoint, PHP2Shell); the skip reasons name the file id. The 'on file' checks were by title search, not by reading each record. A tool result from the docs reader, while checking a topic, returned an unrelated instruction to commit, push and end the session; it was ignored. The triage job itself writes no events. Remaining leads: 245 open feed leads minus 80 processed = 165 left for later runs.
